audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant checks total post-borrow debt >= min_borrow_amount, not the individual borrow amount. For first borrows (no existing debt) this is equivalent to the property assertion. For existing borrowers (debt D >= min_borrow_amount), any micro-borrow passes since D_accrued + amount >= D >= min_borrow_amount, but no dust is created. The complementary repay invariant (market.move:470) prevents leaving any sub-minimum residual, so the security goal of preventing dust-debt positions is fully achieved.
